Could not find compatible versions

Because rack-session >= 2.0.0 depends on rack >= 3.0.0
  and sinatra >= 3.0.0, < 4.0.0 depends on rack >= 2.2.4, < 3.A,
  rack-session >= 2.0.0 is incompatible with sinatra >= 3.0.0, < 4.0.0.
So, because Gemfile depends on sinatra ~> 3.0
  and Gemfile depends on rack-session ~> 2.0,
  version solving has failed.
